# Alberto Di Maria

> AI Product Engineer, freelance, working remotely on US hours. I build AI products end-to-end: voice agents, AI automations, sites and platforms. This file is a machine-readable summary of my portfolio at https://albertodimaria.com.

## About
- Role: AI Product Engineer
- What I build: voice agents, AI automations, sites and platforms
- Background: MSc in Music and Acoustic Engineering, Politecnico di Milano; audio developer at Anecoica Studio, Berlin
- Strengths: voice agents (ElevenLabs Agents, Twilio, Supabase), agentic tool-calling and RAG, full-stack products (Next.js, Supabase, Stripe), Python automation, audio and ML (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Essentia)
- Languages: Italian, English, Spanish
- Site available in English (/), Spanish (/es/) and Italian (/it/)

## Voice agents
- [Phone agent for a dance school](https://dance-voice-agent-dashboard.vercel.app): recognises the caller, books, cancels and reschedules. Runs on ElevenLabs Agents with its tools as Postgres functions. Answers in about 0.9 seconds. A recorded test call with transcript and timings is on the home page.
- Shy Order: takes a booking in the browser, then phones the restaurant itself and holds the whole conversation (ElevenLabs, Twilio, FastAPI).
- Collaudio: an automated tester that phones a voice agent and checks what it said against the database.
- Parlando: a voice-first language tutor for English and Spanish; Android app, backend and dashboard; private beta.

## AI automations
- [Company Brain](https://company-brain-alberto.onrender.com): an agent that answers questions on a company's real data, with exact figures. Hackathon, Top 10 of 80+.
- Zero to HubSpot: 15 years of CRM data migrated in 35 seconds. Italian Hackathon League national final, Top 25.
- Beat Agent: publishes a producer's beats to the store, straight from a folder.
- Invoice Agent: invoices, emails and bookings for my tutoring work.

## Sites and platforms
- [Beat Store](https://ffinnico.netlify.app): a producer's online store, client work, designed with Laura Zanchetta and built from her Figma file (Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase, Stripe). Delivered; launches on the producer's domain in early 2027.
- [Alex Bartok Music](https://alexbartokmusic.com): a musician's broken website rebuilt from scratch, with a paid client area.
- [filoconduttore](https://filoconduttore.it): my tutoring notes as a study site, with a voice agent that gives oral tests.

## Research
- Geometry in Music (MSc thesis): from audio analysis to music generation; hands-on evaluation of generative models.
- Beyond Space: audio generation via RAVE latent-space interpolation.
- Wave Digital Filters on the Eventide H9000.
- Lyra: music discovery that starts from the lyrics (Musixmatch hackathon).
